svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT ALPHA detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent Alpha routes bounded AUTOBOT reference requests while the separate Agenda settings remain empty until explicitly selected. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: AUTOBOT references and optional Agenda settings
Find the relevant AUTOBOT reference for this task.
Keep Agenda empty unless I choose a setting.
Agent Alpha routes up to ten bounded reference functions.
Agenda defaults to empty; no worker or scheduler starts automatically.
